variants.name: c-07-verification
variants.description: Deterministic validation receipt for C-07 PGlite run/event persistence and PEM local-first bootstrap

notes: C-07 implementation tasks 1.1 through 4.1 are complete; task 4.2 is the verification gate represented by this receipt.
Frontend typecheck, lint, architecture boundaries, six focused test files, strict OpenSpec validation, and diff integrity pass.
PGlite migration and repository tests cover additive idempotency, repeated wire sequences, duplicate event identities, and offline ordered reads.
The persistence writer coalesces content spans, preserves server run identity, retains RAW rows, and records terminal phase timings.
The PEM local-first bootstrap test proves hydration completes before realtime subscription and no application outbox schema is introduced.
The full frontend suite was accidentally run earlier in C-07 by an extra argument separator and passed at that point; it is not used as final Wave 3 evidence.
